Title: FG says Moody’s positive outlook validates Nigeria’s economic reforms
Summary: The Federal Government of Nigeria states that a positive outlook from Moody's Investors Service validates the country's ongoing economic reforms.

Title: NDDC begins reconstruction of 15.4km failed section on Benin-Sapele Expressway
Summary: The Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC) has commenced the reconstruction of a 15.4km failed section of the Benin-Sapele Expressway. The project was highlighted by Delta State Governor Sheriff Oborevwori as a significant infrastructure intervention.

Title: Benin-Asaba Road: Umahi gives CCECC 14-day deadline as motorists lament gridlock - Premium Times Nigeria
Summary: The Minister of Works, David Umahi, has issued a 14-day deadline to CCECC to address gridlock and progress on the Benin-Asaba Road project.

Title: Reps warn NNPCL over silence on refinery rehabilitation - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: The House of Representatives has issued a warning to the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL) regarding its lack of transparency and silence concerning the progress of refinery rehabilitation projects.

Title: Tinubu orders NDDC to reconstruct Warri-Sapele-Benin road – Official - Premium Times Nigeria
Summary: President Tinubu has directed the Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC) to undertake the reconstruction of the Warri-Sapele-Benin road.

Title: Tinubu Orders NDDC To Begin Reconstruction Of Warri-Benin Highway - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: President Tinubu has directed the Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC) to commence the reconstruction of the Warri-Benin Highway.

Title: Nigerian Leader Orders Forensic Audit of Federal Systems - Voice of Nigeria
Summary: The Nigerian President has ordered a forensic audit of federal systems to ensure transparency and accountability within government operations.

Title: PRESIDENT TINUBU MOURNS NPC CHAIRMAN, DR. AMINU YUSUF - The State House, Abuja
Summary: President Tinubu has issued a statement mourning the passing of Dr. Aminu Yusuf, the Chairman of the Nigerian Postal Service (NPC). This results in a vacancy for the leadership position of the agency.

Title: Fake Agency Scandal: Tinubu orders forensic audit of IPPIS, MDAs - Premium Times Nigeria
Summary: President Tinubu has ordered a forensic audit of the Integrated Personnel and Payroll Information System (IPPIS) and various Ministries, Departments, and Agencies (MDAs) following the discovery of a fake agency scandal.

Title: Oil revenue shortfall hits N6.69trn as Nigeria’s fiscal pressure deepens - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: Nigeria is experiencing a significant fiscal shortfall of N6.69 trillion in oil revenues, increasing the country's fiscal pressure.

Title: Ogun bans unapproved motorcycle groups from revenue collection - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: The Ogun State government has issued a ban on unapproved motorcycle groups from engaging in revenue collection activities.

Title: EXCLUSIVE: Apart from PFIPC, Adeyemi created other fake agencies, opened bank accounts for them - ICPC - Premium Times Nigeria
Summary: The ICPC has revealed that an individual named Adeyemi created multiple fake agencies, including the PFIPC, and opened fraudulent bank accounts in their names.

Title: OpenAI to end Cursor deal with SpaceX over contract, safety concerns - Premium Times Nigeria
Summary: OpenAI is reportedly ending its deal with Cursor regarding SpaceX due to concerns over contract terms and safety.

Title: NAFDAC seals six Lagos Trade Fair shops over unregistered cosmetics | - theeagleonline.com.ng
Summary: NAFDAC has sealed six shops at the Lagos Trade Fair for selling unregistered cosmetic products. This represents a regulatory enforcement action against non-compliant corporate entities.
